about_the_game:
Hiss & Hunt is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer snake game with pixel art visuals, where you control a hungry snake in a chaotic arena. Every piece of food you eat makes your snake grow, increasing both your reach and the risk.

Use your speed boost to escape danger or grab food before your opponents. There’s no penalty for boosting, so feel free to use it as much as you want! But be cautious: if you crash into a wall or another snake, you’re out. Fortunately, you can respawn instantly and jump right back into the action.

🐍 Current Features:

  • 🕹️ Online multiplayer via Steam Lobby

  • 🎮 Supports mouse, keyboard, and controllers

  • 🌍 One simple, square map where food spawns randomly

  • ⚡ Unlimited speed boost with no cooldown or penalty

  • 🧬 Unlockable snake skins to customize your look

  • ⏱️ Timed matches or endless free-for-all mode

  • 🔁 Instant respawn and jump back into the game

This is the current state of the game, and we’re actively working on adding more content and features as we continue development. More maps, skins, and gameplay options will be coming soon!
